product.title: Key West: All-Inclusive Watersports Adventure with Lunch & Beer

description.text: Cool off in Key West on a half-day water sports tour that features 10 different water activities for you to try, from jet skiing to parasailing to banana boat rides to snorkeling, and much more. Enjoy lunch and draft beer on the way back to the marina for those over the age of 21.A great Key West experience for locals and tourists alike Take a boat out to sea for a day of water activities Ideal for adventure-seekers and water-lovers Lunch, drinks, and all equipment is included in the cost of booking Equipment, beverages, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the water and island scenery. Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
